components.description: White reading card with answer and source references.
components.html:
Answer from your sources

Your answer appears here with numbered citations.

1 Official source ↗
Combined search · 1 passage
components.css: .ds-answer-card{font-family:var(--font,'IBM Plex Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif);padding:24px;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#152238);border:1px solid var(--line,#dfe3e5);border-radius:12px}.ds-answer-card h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 20px}.ds-answer{font-size:18px;line-height:1.8;max-width:72ch;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-answer p{margin:0}.ds-answer-links{margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dfe3e5);font-size:12px}.ds-answer-card a{color:var(--accent,#0759df);text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-answer-card a:hover{color:var(--accent-hover,#0645ab)}.ds-answer-card a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0759df);outline-offset:4px}.ds-answer-card small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#5a6572);margin-top:16px}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-answer-card{padding:20px}}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-answer{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-answer-card,.ds-answer,.ds-answer-links{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Source disclosure
components.description: Expandable official passage in the evidence area.
components.html:
1Official sourceCited in this answer
Original source text appears here.
Open official source ↗
components.css: .ds-source{font-family:var(--font,'IBM Plex Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif);background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#152238);padding:16px;border-radius:9px}.ds-source summary{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;min-height:42px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-source summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-source summary::after{content:"+";font-size:20px;margin-left:auto;color:#54675a;line-height:1.2}.ds-source[open] summary::after{content:"−"}.ds-source summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0759df);outline-offset:4px}.ds-number{background:#eef1f3;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-source-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.6}.ds-cited{display:block;color:#356047;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;margin-top:3px}.ds-passage{font-family:var(--font,'IBM Plex Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif);font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;background:#f1f5f0;color:#384c40;padding:14px;border-radius:6px;max-height:260px;overflow:auto;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:14px 0}.ds-source-link{display:inline-block;color:var(--accent,#0759df);font-size:12px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 0;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-source-link:hover{color:var(--accent-hover,#0645ab)}.ds-source-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0759df);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-source,.ds-number,.ds-source-title,.ds-cited,.ds-passage,.ds-source-link{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Question composer
components.description: Growing question field with an adjacent send action.
components.css: .ds-composer{font-family:var(--font,'IBM Plex Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif);display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-end;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ccd4db;background:var(--surface,#fff);border-radius:12px}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent,#0759df);outline:2px solid #cbdfff;outline-offset:1px}.ds-composer textarea{font-family:var(--font,'IBM Plex Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif);flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;resize:none;min-height:48px;max-height:112px;padding:12px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#152238);font-size:16px;line-height:24px;caret-color:var(--accent,#0759df)}.ds-composer textarea:focus{outline:none}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:#626e7c;opacity:1}.ds-composer-send{width:48px;height:48px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:var(--accent,#0759df);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-composer-send:hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#0645ab)}.ds-composer-send:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0759df);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:900px){.ds-composer{padding:8px;gap:4px}.ds-composer textarea{padding:10px 8px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-composer,.ds-composer-send{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The approved workspace uses an ink-blue navigation rail, warm stone ground, white answer cards and a sage evidence panel. Blue identifies actions and citations. Original passages remain visually distinct from generated answers.

Humanist sans-serif text supports English and Korean reading. Modest serif headings mark the question workspace and its evidence area. Borders and background changes separate content without floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings with bilingual sans-serif reading text.

rules.name: The Evidence Separation Rule
rules.body: Use the sage panel for original sources and white cards for answers.

dos: Do use blue for actions, citations and focus indicators.
Do keep original passages visually separate from answer prose.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do stack evidence after the conversation on small screens.
donts: Don't apply shadows to ordinary answer or source cards.
Don't replace the reading font with the display serif.
Don't use status color without its accompanying text.
